using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests;

public class SuiteCommandTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly SuiteCommand _suiteCommand;

    public SuiteCommandTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
        _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

        // Create minimal dependencies with mocks
        var cmdHelperMock = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
        var nugetServiceMock = new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>(new Mock<ILogger<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>>().Object);
        var packageCheckerMock = new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>();
        var authServiceMock = new Mock<AuthService>();
        var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>();
        var suiteSettingsMock = new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>();

        _suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            nugetServiceMock.Object,
            packageCheckerMock.Object,
            cmdHelperMock.Object,
            authServiceMock.Object,
            httpClientFactoryMock.Object,
            suiteSettingsMock.Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KillSuite_WhenExceptionOccurs_ShouldLogErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

        // Use reflection to invoke private method and throw exception
        var processes = Array.Empty<Process>();
        _suiteCommand.GetType()
            .GetMethod("GetProcessesRelatedWithSuite", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
            .Invoke(_suiteCommand, null);

        // Act & Assert
        var exceptionThrown = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => InvokePrivateMethod("KillSuite", _suiteCommand));
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Cannot close Suite.") && v.ToString().Contains(exception.Message)),
                exception,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KillSuite_WhenProcessesExistAndKilledSuccessfully_ShouldLogSuccessMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockProcess = new Mock<Process>();
        mockProcess.Setup(p => p.Kill());

        // Replace processes via reflection for test
        var processesField = typeof(SuiteCommand).GetMethod("GetProcessesRelatedWithSuite", 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
        
        // Act
        try
        {
            InvokePrivateMethod("KillSuite", _suiteCommand);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Expected if no processes, but verify log
        }

        // Assert - verify the success log call
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Suite closed.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce
        );
    }

    private static void InvokePrivateMethod(string methodName, SuiteCommand instance, params object[] args)
    {
        var method = typeof(SuiteCommand).GetMethod(methodName, 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
        method!.Invoke(instance, args);
    }
}
